title: Nice slide-top Ziplock bag organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer but not labeled
text:
Nice slide-top Ziplock bag organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer but not labeled. This is a nice four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. The unit has a slide top for easy loading. I find it is just as easy to insert the bags through their holes as long as I am not filling with too many bags.This can be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it.

They did provide some stickers to select the bag type. This allows this to be configured the way one wants. However, this organizer is so nice that the stickers cheapen the look. Also, based on the photo on the Amazon site, I expected the compartments to be etched with the name of the bags. I really wish the labels were etched into the bamboo. I also wish they provided some rubberized "circles" on the bottom to keep it from sliding around a drawer or for marring the surface of a wall. I also wish they provided three screws with mollies for hanging to a stud.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely a quality unit but it's unfortunate one has to use stickers to label them. Note that the vendor name is etched on the side of the unit. The current price of $22.39 is reasonably priced for this. Other options that are available are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
